mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% (vs. baseline 34.1% negative rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (vs. baseline 34.1% negative rate).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 6.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO) reflects robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when INDPRO rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment turns bearish.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1400.0 (vs. baseline 34.1% negative rate).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment rate and federal funds rate above 3.5% signal a tightening monetary cycle that is harming the labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (vs. baseline 34.1% negative rate).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5%) indicates an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when GDPC1 growth rate falls below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
